sources.title: Node.js 24 child process exit, streams and IPC reference
sources.supports: Process exit and stdio closure are distinct observations; fork/disconnect/kill operate on a child handle and IPC channel. Reference version is 24.21.0; actual test runtime stays pinned 24.22.1.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 advisory locking functions
sources.supports: The existing pair uses a cooperative transaction-level advisory lock. The proof checks actual pg_locks/session disappearance after process termination, without a durable lock table.
